# @pd2-trader/ui — rules for AI tools building PD2 Trader features and plugins
# Human version: DESIGN_RULES.md (same folder). Lint: eslint-rules/design-system.js (pd2-ds/*).

## Context
- UI runs in ONE transparent, always-on-top, NON-FOCUSABLE overlay window over Diablo II (Tauri 2 + WebView2, Chromium >= 112).
- Stack: React 18, Tailwind 4, shadcn (new-york), Radix, framer-motion, lucide-react, i18next.
- 21 themes (11 dark, 10 light). Every theme defines every token, so style ONLY with tokens.

## Allowed color classes (Tailwind stems; use with bg-/text-/border-/ring-/fill-/stroke-/from-/to-; opacity suffix /10 … /90 ok)
semantic: background foreground surface surface-foreground surface-elevated card card-foreground popover popover-foreground
  primary primary-foreground secondary secondary-foreground muted muted-foreground accent accent-foreground
  destructive destructive-foreground success success-foreground warning warning-foreground info info-foreground
  border input ring scrim chart-1 chart-2 chart-3 chart-4 chart-5
  sidebar sidebar-foreground sidebar-primary sidebar-primary-foreground sidebar-accent sidebar-accent-foreground sidebar-border sidebar-ring
domain: glow q-unique q-set q-rare q-magic q-crafted q-rune q-normal q-gold q-corrupted q-corrupted-zone
keywords: transparent current inherit (and currentColor in SVG)
inline styles: var(--<token>) only, e.g. style={{ color: 'var(--q-unique)' }}; color-mix(in oklab, var(--success) 20%, transparent) ok.

## Token meaning (pick by meaning, not by hue)
surface = panel body (follows window transparency); surface-elevated = tooltip/popover/toast over a panel;
card = tile in a panel; popover = Radix menu/select/popover content; muted = quiet fill, muted-foreground = secondary text/icons;
accent = hover/active row; primary = the main action; destructive = error/delete; success = sold/synced/price up;
warning = stale/partial; info = notice; border/input/ring = hairline/input border/focus; scrim = dimmer behind sheets;
glow = theme highlight (shadow-glow); q-* = Diablo II item quality colors: item names ALWAYS use their q-* color; never use q-* for non-item meaning.

## Scales
spacing: Tailwind default 4px scale (gap-1 gap-1.5 gap-2, p-1.5 p-2 p-3, px-2.5). Half steps ok. No brackets.
type: text-xs = body, text-sm = titles/values, text-base+ = hero numbers only. font-medium / font-semibold. Numbers: tabular-nums.
radius: rounded-sm (chips) rounded-md (controls, tiles) rounded-lg (panels) rounded-xl rounded-full (pills). Derived from per-theme --radius.
elevation: shadow-panel (panels, popovers), shadow-glow (highlighted item). Not shadow-lg.
z: z-raised (sticky header) z-popup (in-panel menu/scrim) z-drawer (in-panel sidebar) z-panel (overlay panels) z-floating (portalled popovers/tooltips/dialogs).
motion: ease-out ease-spring; duration-(--dur-fast)=120ms duration-(--dur-med)=200ms duration-(--dur-slow)=300ms.
  framer presets: import { fadeIn, fadeInUp, scaleIn, slideInRight, slideInLeft, listStagger, listItem, springSnappy, springSoft, useReducedMotionSafe } from '@/lib/motion'.
  Gate JS transforms with useReducedMotionSafe(); use motion-safe: for CSS animation classes.
icons: lucide-react only. size-3 (dense chip), size-3.5 (inline with text-xs), size-4 (buttons, chrome bar). Use size-*, not h-4 w-4. Decorative: aria-hidden. Icon-only button: aria-label via i18n.

## Banned (pd2-ds lint; warn in src/**, error in packages/ui/**)
- raw colors anywhere in TSX classes/styles/props: #fff #1a1a1a rgb() rgba() hsl() oklch() oklab() lab() lch() hwb()
- Tailwind palette classes: bg-red-500 text-zinc-400 border-white text-black/50 ring-blue-400 (any hue-step or white/black)
- arbitrary values with raw numbers on spacing/size/type/radius/border: w-[312px] text-[13px] text-[11px] p-[7px] rounded-[4px] max-h-[calc(100vh-2rem)]
  (allowed: var-only values like w-[var(--radix-popover-trigger-width)], keywords like rounded-[inherit])
- window.alert / window.confirm / window.prompt (wedge the non-focusable window; lint no-alert)
- DOM keydown listeners for hotkeys; stealing focus on open; Promise.withResolvers and other APIs newer than Chromium 112
- hard-coded UI strings (use i18n t('...'))
Escape hatch (rare, reason required): `// ds-allow: <reason>` on the line above (JSX: {/* ds-allow: <reason> */}),
or `// eslint-disable-next-line pd2-ds/no-arbitrary-value -- <reason>`.

## Components and import paths
Now (M1): shadcn primitives live in the app at src/components/ui/* (import '@/components/ui/<name>'):
  alert alert-dialog badge breadcrumb button button-group card chart checkbox dialog dropdown-menu form input label
  popover progress scroll-area select separator sheet skeleton slider sonner switch table tabs textarea toggle toggle-group tooltip
Overlay patterns: '@/components/custom/window-chrome' (WindowChrome, WindowPanel), '@/components/custom/hover-popover' (HoverPopover),
  '@/components/custom/popover-parts' (PopoverTile, PopoverKeyValue, PopoverSectionTitle),
  '@/pages/currency/components/StatePanel' (Banner tone=info|warning|destructive, EmptyState).
Toasts/confirm: import { showToast, confirmToast, undoToast } from '@/overlay' (src/overlay/toast.tsx).
Class merge: import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'. Variants: cva from 'class-variance-authority'.
Tokens (TS): import { THEME_TOKENS, SEMANTIC_TOKENS, DOMAIN_TOKENS, EASING, DURATION_MS, Z_LAYERS } from '@pd2-trader/ui/tokens'.
Tailwind theme CSS: @import '@pd2-trader/ui/tailwind.css'.
M2: components move to @pd2-trader/ui (primitives, PanelChrome, HoverPopover, ItemName, PriceTag, Slot* components). Update imports then; do not deep-import src/components/ui internals from plugins.

## States
loading: <Skeleton className="h-4 w-24" /> shaped like the content (no spinners for content).
empty: <EmptyState icon title description action />: say what is empty and the next step.
error: <Banner tone="destructive"> in-panel; toast for transient results; plugin slot failure → ErrorChip (M2/M3).
interactive: hover:bg-accent, focus = global outline-ring/50, disabled:opacity-50.

## Copy
Sentence case, short, plain, no "!". "…" for in-progress ("Opening browser…"), "·" as separator.
Errors: what happened + what to do. Use PD2 vocabulary (HR, runes, corrupted, Hell games).

## Minimal example
<WindowPanel>
  <WindowChrome title={t('myPlugin.title')} icon={<Coins />} onClose={close} />
  <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-2 text-xs">
    <span className="font-medium text-q-unique">{item.name}</span>
    <span className="tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{t('myPlugin.price', { value })}</span>
    <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onList}>{t('myPlugin.list')}</Button>
  </div>
</WindowPanel>
